title: How ERC-8004 composes with the other seven
caption: ERC-8004 is an identity and reputation layer with one strong documented link (x402), one citation (the MPP discovery draft), one indirect path (A2A to AP2) and no documented link to TAP, ACP, UCP or Agent Pay as of 2026-10-11. Companion ERCs build around it.
alt: Flowchart. ERC-8004 in the center. x402 is linked by x402Support, agentWallet as payee and proofOfPayment in feedback files. Stripe MPP discovery draft cites ERC-8004 for possible future on-chain anchoring. AP2 connects indirectly through A2A agent cards listed as services. Visa TAP, OpenAI ACP, Google UCP and Mastercard Agent Pay have no documented relation. Companion standards ERC-8122, ERC-8217, ERC-8126, ERC-8183 and ERC-8226 build on or around ERC-8004; ERC-8226 bridges to ERC-3643 regulated tokens.
